title: Forecasting cephalosporin and monobactam antibiotic half-lives in humans from data collected in laboratory animals
quote: The postdistribution half-lives of 10 cephalosporin and 2 monobactam antibiotics in humans were predicted

verified_quotes.text: The postdistribution half-lives of 10 cephalosporin and 2 monobactam antibiotics in humans were predicted

summary: An antibiotic benchmark for body-weight allometry of human postdistribution half-life and physiological-time normalization.
validation: Predicts a PK parameter, not a complete exposure-response model. Related ceftizoxime publications may reuse evidence and are not independent validations.
data_availability: Open scanned full text available; this entry verified at abstract level. Machine-readable raw data not verified.
